bias.en: Bearish · closed under the 200-day, lowest since July
bias.zh: 看空 · 收于 200 日均线下方，创 7 月以来新低

read.en: TSMC fell 1.8% on Nov 2 to $398.63, its lowest close since Jul 29, near the day's $398.29 low after a $414.76 high. It is below the rising 5-day ($422.6), falling 10-day ($422.5), 30-day ($441.7) and 100-day ($429.5), just under the rising 200-day ($400.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($440.06), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 台积电 11月2日下跌 1.8%，收于 $398.63，为 7月29日以来最低收盘，接近日内低点 $398.29，盘中高点为 $414.76。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$422.6）以及下行的 10 日（$422.5）、30 日（$441.7）和 100 日均线（$429.5）下方，略低于上行的 200 日均线（$400.5）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$440.06），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close broke the $405.2–405.5 and $400.1–400.5 supports, including the 200-day, now resistance. Resistance is $400.1–400.5 (200-day, Oct 30 low), then $405.2–411.1 (June, August and October lows) and $422.5–422.6 (5 and 10-day). Support is $398.2–398.8 (Jul 31, Aug 3 and Nov 2 lows), then $381.3–388.8 (late-July lows) and $372.7 (Jul 29 low). A close above $400.5 would target $405–411; below $398, $386–388.
